description: Answers to the questions people ask when buying a used or new commercial bus: CDL and licensing, federal school bus and accessibility rules, inspecting a used bus, title, registration and insurance, financing and grants, delivery, and buses for churches, schools, camps, senior living, NEMT, shuttles and skoolies. Returns the closest written answers with their official sources and a link to each on CommercialBuses. If nothing matches, says so and gives the page where a person can be asked.

limit.description: How many answers to return. Default 3.

question.description: The buyer's question in their own words.

name: answer_bus_question
